label: Restart Web Workers (Dev Appliances Only)
mcp_tool_description: Recycle CloudBolt's web worker processes so a UI extension (XUI) you just synced loads its new routes and views, instead of asking a human to run systemctl restart httpd. For DEVELOPMENT appliances only: it works on any appliance it is synced to, and requires a CloudBolt admin caller. Set dev_web_restart_dry_run to true to list the workers without restarting them. It recycles the 10 workers one at a time and waits for each to finish importing before the next, so the portal keeps answering. It takes 2.5 to 3 minutes on a typical appliance (about 15 s per worker). While it runs, some requests may still reach workers with old code (a new extension route can 404 until the roll finishes), and a request in flight on the worker being recycled is cut off with a 502; retry it. Returns a job id: poll it with short calls (fetch_job_log, or fetch_job without a long wait_seconds), because a long-held request is likely to land on a worker being recycled; the output has perWorker, totalSeconds, oldWorkerPids, newWorkerPids, signalledCount and the HTTP probe result. Admin only. Never use on a production appliance.
